svg.text: The core account: what supports what
A → B: A is used in the proof of B. Assumptions on the left; implied arrows removed.

g.title: LeanDag.FinWhale.Creation.lemma18 — the two delivery lemmas, derived from C1, C2 and C3
LeanDag.BlockUniverse.exists_common_mem_of_quorums — two quorum-backed sets of round-`n` blocks share a block
LeanDag.ValidWrt.iff_validAt — the core's validity is the validity family at its quorum, with distinct creators and a self-parent
LeanDag.BlockRecord.eq_of_creator_eq — non-equivocation, in usable form, at any record
LeanDag.ViewPace.covers_of_converges — the referencing clause, unfused from the network's
LeanDag.ViewPace.driftOn_of_catchup — drift is derived, at the collapsed constant
LeanDag.Properties.Banded — the four properties a rule shows
LeanDag.exists_correct_mem_inter — two quorums share a correct validator
LeanDag.Properties.Support — the support and its two laws; the precondition every liveness theorem reads
LeanDag.directCommit_of_leader_mem — a correct leader is committed
LeanDag.FinWhale.direct_commit_unique — a fast commit excludes a second commit, a skip, and any other indirect commit: FinWhale's laws
LeanDag.FinWhale.decided_of_wellFormed — safety with the views and the reverse pass supplied rather than assumed: the pass lands in the relation
LeanDag.PaceCore.viewAt — liveness is local: a validator decides on its own view
LeanDag.AnchoredRule.decided_unique — agreement, once for every anchored rule
LeanDag.Properties.DagRule — the carrier a mechanism reads, with its three laws
LeanDag.Scheme.ReadAlike.decided_iff — two anchored rules that read alike decide alike, and have one carrier
LeanDag.Scheme.votes_iff — one round up, a vote is a reference and a blame is a reference to no candidate

LeanDag.Scheme.eq_of_noEquiv_all — where nobody equivocates, the two-round inequalities without `n + f + 1 ≤ commit + link` and the three-round ones without `n + f + 1 ≤ 2·cert` give agreement at every vote; Nemo-Nemo and Async Nemo-Nemo meet them at `n = 2c + 1` and agree; with `q = n − c` they need `n ≥ 2c + 1`, and `3c + 1` for a two-round row with a direct skip within the liveness bound

LeanDag.Scheme.readAlike_hydrozoanSlow — on Hydrozoan's universe the Hybrid Mysticeti row decides as Hydrozoan without its fast path, at every vote; it meets its inequalities at every `n ≥ 3f + 2c + 1`, and its carrier is safe and progresses under Hydrozoan's fault model, and with self-reference lives
LeanDag.ViewPace.heldOf_inj — a pacing structure induces a delivery layer; the acceptance rule is derived
LeanDag.FinWhale.lemma4 — a fast commit makes every block two rounds up FP-evidence for it
LeanDag.directCommit_of_correct_leader — at `T := Correct`
LeanDag.FinWhale.lemma22 — three consecutive correct leaders in every window of `3f + 3`
LeanDag.exists_reliable_parent — the rush bound: a valid block certifies the honest floor
LeanDag.commits_recur_on — commits recur
LeanDag.AnchoredRule.commitSeq_agree — the committed-leader sequence is agreed
LeanDag.AnchoredRule.decided_below_of_committed_run — a committed run of eligible span clears everything below
LeanDag.AnchoredRule.decided_full — decisions propagate to the full view
LeanDag.AnchoredRule.decided_mono — decisions are monotone in the view
LeanDag.AnchoredRule.eq_of_decided_commit — corollaries of agreement
LeanDag.FinWhale.equivocating_margin — the committee is the least at which that holds, and the counting behind the findings of §20.8
LeanDag.FinWhale.lemma23 — every slot below a committed triple is decided, and the sequences then coincide
LeanDag.FinWhale.theorem14 — the delivery order extends rather than revises, and repeats nothing
LeanDag.PaceCore.drift_collapse — drift collapses to `Δ + proc`, from any spread
LeanDag.PaceCore.refs_held — the converse of P7 on the trunk; liveness with bounded storage from one structure
LeanDag.Properties.Arcs.decided_of_truncate — verdicts across a cut, a fill, and any stack of mechanisms
LeanDag.Properties.Safe — the safety headline: across any stack, and at every slot across an extension
LeanDag.Properties.SelfParent.reaches_of_creator — inclusion from self-reference: a reliable block reaches its author's next commit

LeanDag.Scheme.SchemeReactive.reached — the family run reactively, pacing at a quorum `q`: a reliable block reaches the leader block round by round, votes and certifies; that is the family support's precondition at any reliability, so a reliably-led slot commits, at the hybrid committees too; with self-reference no reliable block is censored; Reactive Mysticeti is an instance
LeanDag.Scheme.cordialLaws — Cordial Miners PS is the core with no direct skip, with the core's laws
LeanDag.Scheme.decided_none_of_novel — the prompt skip: a novel slot is skipped, and conflicts with no verdict
LeanDag.Scheme.decisionAt_complete — at the rows of SC12, the loop decides every verdict `Decided` derives once its scan reaches far enough, and outputs it once every slot from `lo` is decided

LeanDag.Scheme.exists_commonCore — the asynchronous rows are live under the coin: at `2q ≥ n + f + 1` a common core; a safe block is good; one buffer round gives an honest good validator and the double count, two give `q − f`; leaders outnumbering the rest include a good one; under the coin clause a good leader commits, windows commit and slots below a run are decided; a uniform coin names a good leader with probability bounded below, and its misses vanish
LeanDag.Scheme.leastSel — a vote-selection rule exists: the least block of the slot in the voter's history
LeanDag.Scheme.leastSel_local — the least vote and the scheme's vote are local
LeanDag.Scheme.nemoBlameLaws — Nemo-Nemo at `n = 2c + 1` is Nemo with a direct skip on a blame from every validator, with Nemo's laws

LeanDag.Scheme.schemeBandLaws — at a local vote, a wave of at least two and positive thresholds, the family's carrier is banded; at every row and vote it shows `CommitsCandidate`, `CommitsDirect`, `Indirect`, `Quorate`, `NoEquiv` (and `SelfParent` on the core's universes); at every row meeting its inequalities it agrees and is safe

LeanDag.Scheme.schemeOrder_slots — the scheme's loop over rounds and leader indices, both downward, outputs `tryDecide` between the corresponding slots, and under `Slots.uniform` each pair is its slot's round and leader index; at the rows of SC12, its restart at the round of the last decision, dropping the slots already output, resumes it on a larger view

LeanDag.Scheme.tryDecide_eq_map — the output from slot `0` is `commitSeq` and `ledgerSet` of the loop's assignment, every slot below its length decided with that verdict; at the rows of SC12 two validators' ledgers are nested
LeanDag.Scheme.tryDecide_prefix — at the rows of SC12, two validators' loop outputs are prefix-comparable

LeanDag.Scheme.tryDecide_restart — a call restarting inside an earlier output repeats its tail; at the rows of SC12, calls on growing views, each restarting after the last decision output, output what one call on the last view outputs
LeanDag.Scheme.tryDecide_sound — the commit loop outputs only verdicts `Decided` derives from the same view, at consecutive slots, at positive link and certificate thresholds

LeanDag.Scheme.twoRoundLaws — on records with quorum `q` and at most `f` validators that may equivocate, every two-round row meeting `TwoRound n f q` and every three-round row with a link of one certificate meeting `ThreeRound n f q` has the anchored laws and agrees, at every vote; Hybrid Mysticeti, Hybrid Mahi-Mahi, Orcaella at every `n ≥ 5f + 3c + 1` and Async Orcaella agree
LeanDag.View.mem_of_reaches — causal history does not escape a view
LeanDag.ViewPace — a partial build schedule, in which *stuck* is expressible: the structure, production, and the spine
LeanDag.convergesWithin_iff_bounded — the bound factored out of convergence
LeanDag.decided_none_of_leader_absent — an absent leader is skipped
LeanDag.decided_of_committed_above — a committed slot above decides everything below (spaced schedules)
LeanDag.decided_of_first_eligible_commit — a slot resolves through its first eligible commit
LeanDag.ledgerSet_mono — the ledger is monotone and agreed
LeanDag.outputAt_unique — a block enters at one slot, agreed
LeanDag.round_le_of_reaches — causal history is non-increasing in round
LeanDag.waveRobin — a schedule satisfying L10's fairness and shape hypotheses exists at every committee: the wave-aligned rotation, with no premise beyond the fault model

LeanDag.Timing.waits — Timing.waits
LeanDag.Properties.Persist.of_banded — what is derived: persistence, truncation invariance, leader commits, descent
LeanDag.FinWhale.Creation.lemma20 — both commit paths on the reactive schedule
LeanDag.FinWhale.leaderClause_of_dosValid — a DoS-valid universe is a FinWhale DAG at any leader schedule
LeanDag.Scheme.Safety.votedBlockIsVote — the scheme's vote, a depth-first search of the parents in any order listing them all, is a vote-selection rule
LeanDag.Scheme.sel_eq_none_iff_blames — below the voter, every vote-selection rule blames as Mahi-Mahi blames, and the least vote is Mahi-Mahi's vote
LeanDag.certificates_eq_empty_of_directSkip — a skipped block has no certificate anywhere
LeanDag.exists_certificate_reaches_of_directCommit — a committed block's certificate is unavoidable from `r+3`
LeanDag.eq_of_certificates_nonempty — certificate uniqueness
LeanDag.exists_correct_common_support — correct-support counting
LeanDag.ViewPace.synchronisedOn_of_converges — coverage from view convergence, drift-free
LeanDag.Properties.Support.Lives — the liveness headline: progress and inclusion at the rule's support
LeanDag.Scheme.familySupport_local — the family's support has its three laws, and the carrier lives on the core's universes at every vote
LeanDag.card_authorsAt_of_lt — the DAG is dense below its frontier
LeanDag.reaches_of_quorum_support — persistence
LeanDag.exists_correct_mem_creators_inter — two quorum-backed identifier sets share a correct author
LeanDag.commits_recur_within — the committing slot, and its round
LeanDag.FinWhaleProperties.agree — two validators never decide a leader slot differently
LeanDag.FinWhale.Run.agreement — what a validator guarantees: agreement, total order, integrity, validity
LeanDag.Properties.Support.live_of_truncates — liveness across a cut, a fill, and any stack
LeanDag.Timed.live_of_coverage — synchrony is the timed model's, not a property: the one bridge into `live`
LeanDag.Scheme.Equiv.mysticetiRow — the Mysticeti, Blue Bottle PS and Orcaella rows are the core's, Odontoceti's and Hybrid's carriers, Orcaella at `n = 5f + 3c + 1`

LeanDag.Scheme.Table.holds — every row meets its family's inequalities and the liveness bound (Cordial Miners but its skip); the inequalities force `n ≥ 5f + 3c + 1` and `n ≥ 3f + 2c + 1` and, there, Orcaella's and Hybrid Mysticeti's thresholds; Nemo-Nemo's row fails the second two-round inequality
LeanDag.Properties.Support.decidedBelow_of_fairRun — every slot below a fair run is decided, at `live`
LeanDag.FinWhale.fastCommit_latency — the fast commit within two message delays, the timeout never firing
LeanDag.FinWhale.Run.ofDoSValidReactive — and on the reactive schedule it is a run, at every horizon; the condition never leaves a builder short of citable authors
LeanDag.Scheme.Safety.holds — at every vote-selection rule, the Mahi-Mahi row at `w ≥ 3`, the Cordial Miners Async row and the Blue Bottle Async row have the anchored laws, and two views decide alike

LeanDag.Scheme.Equiv.mahiMahiRow — at the least vote, the Mahi-Mahi row at `w ≥ 3` is Mahi-Mahi's carrier, the Blue Bottle Async row is Async BlueBottle's, and the Cordial Miners Async row is Mahi-Mahi at wave five with no direct skip, with Mahi-Mahi's laws
LeanDag.not_directCommit_of_directSkip — no block is both committed and skipped
LeanDag.indirect_agrees_with_direct — the indirect rule agrees with the direct
LeanDag.eq_of_directCommit_of_creator_eq — at most one block per slot is directly committed
LeanDag.exists_common_correct_ancestor — a common correct ancestor
LeanDag.ViewPace.directCommit_of_wait — the wait bound
LeanDag.ViewPace.synchronisedOn_of_rate — the round of coverage, explicitly

LeanDag.Scheme.HybridRow.onHydrozoan — every row safe and live: Cordial Miners on the core's universes; Orcaella, Async Orcaella, Hybrid Mysticeti, Hybrid Mahi-Mahi, Nemo-Nemo and Async Nemo-Nemo under the hybrid fault model with self-reference; the asynchronous rows ready for the count
LeanDag.all_decided_below_of_fairRun — every slot below a fair run is decided (pipelined)
